title: Preserve causality in CPU BlockAttnRes summaries
evidence: Reproduced: changing only second token flips first-token logit from +0.54119587 to -0.54119587 in forward and forward_train. Full-sequence mean summaries are broadcast to every token.
fix: Use per-token causal depth summaries; add prefix-invariance and prefill/decode equivalence tests. See cpu_forward_prefix_logits_are_causal and cpu_training_prefix_logits_are_causal.

title: Repair GPU optimizer and autodiff parameter bindings
evidence: Reproduced cross entropy validation: set_immediates size16 exceeds pipeline immediate_size0. WGSL parameters are private zero-initialized variables, not uniform/immediate bindings. Same pattern exists in Adam and autodiff shaders; those variants source-verified only.
fix: Wire parameters consistently through supported bindings, configure pipeline ranges, then verify cross entropy, Adam, and backward numerically. See gpu_cross_entropy_dispatch_is_valid.

title: Upload trained weights in AnyModel file loaders
evidence: Source-verified: from_safetensors/from_gguf only infer configuration then invoke constructors; parsed tensor values never enter created model. Does not implicate separate CPU Gemma loaders.
fix: Validate/map/upload all tensors and compare outputs against a reference checkpoint; missing required weights must error.

title: Enforce Armor when enabled on API server
evidence: Source-verified: serve stores armor in unused _armor field; neither completion handler performs input checks or output sanitization. --armor gives false assurance.
fix: Wire Armor checks into server generation or reject unsupported flag; test blocked input and redacted output through HTTP.

title: Bound HTTP input and enforce connection deadlines
evidence: Source-verified: serial accept loop, unbounded read_line and Content-Length allocation, no read timeout. One idle client blocks all service; huge declared body can exhaust memory. No destructive/OOM probe performed.
fix: Limit headers/body, validate framing and reject over-limit lengths before allocation, enforce deadlines and bounded concurrency. Test slow/incomplete requests safely.

title: Replace substring API request parsing with validated JSON
evidence: Source-verified: parsers always return Some, messages require literal {"role", strings stop at escaped quotes, stream detection requires exact "stream":true. Valid whitespace/key reordering changes meaning and malformed input is accepted.
fix: Use serde request types and range/schema validation; test pretty JSON, reordered keys, escaped content, malformed bodies and streaming booleans.

title: Reject incomplete HTTP bodies instead of zero padding
evidence: Reproduced: declares Content-Length5, sends abc and closes write side; parser returns Some with zero-padded body because read_exact error is ignored.
fix: Propagate read failures and return 400; see truncated_http_body_is_rejected.

title: Serialize all API response fields with JSON escaping
evidence: Reproduced: assistant content containing U+0001 produces invalid JSON. Other string fields such as model/id/role are interpolated without escaping.
fix: Serialize structured responses with serde_json; test control characters and quoted model names. See response_with_control_character_is_valid_json.

title: Implement OpenAI-compatible completion and SSE response schemas
evidence: Source-verified: stream=true computes complete response before returning one full-response SSE event, not chat.completion.chunk delta events. Text completion choices use message instead of text.
fix: Separate text/chat response types, emit real incremental SSE chunks and correct finish reasons; test with an OpenAI client.

title: Enforce host shell timeouts and bounded output capture
evidence: Reproduced: sleep2 with timeout_secs1 completes successfully. Timeout variable unused; Command::output buffers all output before truncation. Post-hoc truncation can also split UTF-8.
fix: Use supervised child/process-group deadlines and bounded concurrent stdout/stderr reads; see shell_timeout_is_enforced.

title: Enforce web_fetch max_bytes during response reads
evidence: Reproduced with local HTTP fixture: 6-byte response returned despite max_bytes1; _max_bytes unused and entire body read into memory.
fix: Read through a bounded reader with explicit truncation/error semantics, including decompressed data; see web_fetch_obeys_byte_limit.

title: Make file_read bounded and UTF-8-safe
evidence: Reproduced: reading é with max_bytes1 panics at byte index1. Entire file is read before applying limit, so max_bytes does not bound memory.
fix: Bound reads before allocation growth and truncate only at valid character boundaries; see file_read_unicode_limit_does_not_panic.

title: Correct autoregressive decode RoPE position off-by-one
evidence: Source-verified: first sampled token follows prompt positions0..N-1 and must use positionN, but both generators pass N+1. Layer uses supplied effective_pos directly.
fix: Use zero-based N+step and test cached logits against full-forward prefix logits, including context-extension modes.

title: Honor zero output-token limits in GPU generators
evidence: Source-verified: first token sampled/appended before max_tokens check, so nonempty prompt with max_tokens0 still produces one token. Audit streaming max_new_tokens0 too.
fix: Return empty output before prefill for zero budget; test buffered and streaming APIs.

title: Use cache-local indices for repeated context compaction
evidence: Source-verified: compaction selects indices from growing global_pos even after physical cache shrinks, and triggers every later step; eventually copies beyond physical capacity. Streaming decode lacks equivalent compaction.
fix: Separate absolute RoPE positions from current physical cache indices, validate every index, and test multiple capacity crossings and streaming parity.

title: Infer attention heads from metadata rather than square projection width
evidence: Source-verified: for square 4096x4096 q_proj, infer_num_heads returns4096, implying head_dim1. Projection shape alone cannot determine head count.
fix: Load architecture config/head metadata and reject ambiguity; test LLaMA-style square Q projection and GQA.

title: Implement architecture-correct standard-transformer gated FFN
evidence: Source-verified: prefill/decode use ReLU(gate)+up, not SiLU(gate)*up required for supported LLaMA/Mistral SwiGLU. Other advertised families require their own activation.
fix: Represent architecture-specific activation/gating and compare per-layer outputs to reference models.

title: Correct autodiff matmul gradient layouts and dispatch coverage
evidence: Source-verified: kernels index B/A as transposed but dispatcher binds original buffers. workgroup_size64 is 1D while Y dispatch is divided by64, so columns are under-covered even after parameter binding repair.
fix: Correct row-major transpose indexing and 2D coverage; use non-square finite-difference gradient checks after A02.

title: Accumulate gradients for every reverse-mode graph edge
evidence: Source-verified: ReLU/softmax/matmul write directly to input gradients while Add/Scale accumulate; multiple consumers overwrite earlier contributions.
fix: Accumulate all contributions using safe temporary buffers or ordered addition; test x feeding two ReLUs and a diamond graph, after A02.

title: Correct RMSNorm autodiff Jacobian and preserve epsilon
evidence: Source-verified: unit-scale formula is inv_rms/d*(g-y*dot(g,y)) rather than inv_rms*(g-y*dot(g,y)/d); dispatcher discards NodeKind epsilon and sends1e-5.
fix: Implement correct normalization/weight derivatives and use node epsilon; verify numerical gradients for multiple rows and non-default epsilon after A02.

title: Replace CLI distillation surrogate gradients with valid chain-rule backprop
evidence: Source-verified: immutable d_hidden= d_logits@lm_head^T is reused unchanged across all layers and substituted/truncated for Q/K/V gradients, omitting attention and normalization Jacobians. Freezing base weights does not justify omission.
fix: Backpropagate through frozen operations to trainable adapters, validate end-to-end finite differences, or explicitly expose approximation as a separate experimental mode.

title: Honor API generation settings and model stop tokens
evidence: Source-verified: chat uses hardcoded256 tokens and temperature0.7; text ignores requested temperature; both pass EOS=None, chat ignores top_p and always reports stop.
fix: Pass validated request configuration and model EOS through generation; test max_tokens0/1, greedy temperature, top_p and finish_reason.

title: Decode API outputs with the loaded tokenizer
evidence: Source-verified: HF tokenizer is retained only as encoding closure, while output IDs are decoded using SimpleTokenizer. Real model vocab IDs yield corrupt output.
fix: Retain encode/decode tokenizer pair and stop silently falling back to incompatible tokenization for loaded models; test HF roundtrip and generated vocabulary IDs.

title: Reject zero or invalid GGUF alignment without panicking
evidence: Reproduced: tiny GGUFv3 file with general.alignment UInt32=0 panics at gguf.rs:785: attempt to divide by zero. See gguf_zero_alignment_returns_error_without_panic.
fix: Validate nonzero supported alignment and checked offset arithmetic; add tiny malformed metadata fixture and fuzz loader.

title: Reject or handle empty prompts in CPU server generation
evidence: Source-verified: empty prompt yields empty token vector with SimpleTokenizer; generate_cpu computes (all_tokens.len()-1)*vocab_size, underflow/index panic. Server JSON parser permits missing/empty prompt and handles requests serially without panic isolation.
fix: Validate nonempty token input or add BOS token, reject invalid requests, and test empty completions with loaded model.
